headline: 今日零新片：罪人领跑电影，Lupin霸榜剧集
headlineEn: Zero New Films Today: The Sinner Leads Movies, Lupin Tops TV
summary: 今日无新片上映，本周有4部新电影；电影端《不存在的罪人》领跑，剧集端《Lupin》《幻视任务》强势，跨榜的《药屋少女的呢喃》也受关注。
summaryEn: With no new films released today and four due this week, The Nonexistent Sinner leads movie heat while Lupin and Vision Quest dominate TV; The Apothecary Diaries also draws cross-chart attention.
